a: उग्र — a. [उच्-रन् गश्चांतादेशः Uṇ. 2. 28] 1 Fierce, cruel, ferocious, savage (as a look &c.); ˚दर्शनः having a fierce or cruel look. --2 Formidable, terrific, frightful, fearful; सिंहनिपातमुग्रं R. 2. 60; Bg. 11. 30; Ms. 6. 75, 12. 75; ˚दंतः, ˚नासिकः &c. --3 Powerful, mighty, strong, violent, intense; उग्रातपां वेलां Ś. 3. intensely hot; उग्रशोकां Me. 113 v.l. --4 Sharp, pungent, hot. --5 High, noble. --6 Angry, passionate, wrathful. --7 Ready to do any work, industrious. --ग्रः 1 N. of Śiva or Rudra. --2 N. of a mixed tribe, descendant of a Kṣatriya father and Śūdra mother (his business being to catch or kill animals dwelling in holes, such as snakes; cf. Ms. 10. 9, 13, 15.). --3 N. of a tree शोभांजनवृक्ष. --4 A group of five asterisms; their names are: -- पूर्वाफाल्गुनी, पूर्वाषाढा, पूर्वाभाद्रपदा, मघा and भरणी. --5 N. of a country called Kerala (Modern Malabar). --6 The sentiment called रौद्र. --7 Wind. --ग्रा 1 N. of different plants; वचा, यवानी, धन्याक. --2 A cruel woman. --ग्री A kind of being belonging to the class of demons. --ग्रं 1 A certain deadly poison, the root of Aconitum Ferox (वत्सनाभविषं). --2 Wrath, anger. --Comp. --ईशः the mighty or terrible lord, N. of Śiva. --कर्मन् a. fierce in action, cruel. --कांडः a sort of gourd (कारवेल). --गंध a. strong-smelling. --(धः) {1} the Campaka tree. {2} N. of other trees also; कट्फल, अर्जकबृक्ष. {3} garlic. --(धा) {1} Orris root. {2} a medicinal plant. {3} N. of various plants; यवानी, वचा, अजमोदा. --(धं) Asa fœtida. --गंधिन् a. strong-smelling. --चयः a strong desire. --चारिणी, --चंडा N. of Durgā. --जाति a. base-born. --तारा N. of a goddess. --तेजस् a. endowed with powerful or terrible energy. --दंष्ट्र a. having terrific teeth. --दंड a. ruling with a rod of iron, stern, cruel, relentless; Pt. 3. --दर्शन, --रूप a. frightful in appearance, fiercelooking, grim, terrible. --दुहितृ f. the daughter of a powerful man. --धन्वन् a. having a powerful bow. (--m.) N. of Śiva and Indra. --नासिक a. large-nosed. --पुत्र a. born in a mighty family. --(त्रः) N. of Kārttikeya. --पूति a. horribly stinking; Māl. 5. 16. --रेतस् m. a form of Rudra. --वीर a. having powerful men. --शासन a. strict in orders, severe in commands. --शेखरा ‘crest of Śiva’, N. of the Ganges. --शोक a. sorely-grieving, deeply afflicted. --श्रवणदर्शन a. terrible to hear and see. --सेनः {1} N. of a son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra. {2} N. of a king of Mathurā and father of Kaṃsa. He was deposed by his son; but Kṛṣṇa after having slain Kaṃsa restored him to the throne. --(ना) N. of the wife of Akrūra; ˚जः N. of Kaṃsa, the uncle and enemy of Kṛṣṇa.

s: strI, (ugrA caRqA kopanA strI .) devIBedaH । yaTA mahizAsuraM prati BagavatIvAkyam । “ugracaRqeti yA mUrttirBadrakAlI hyahaM punaH । yayA mUrttyA tvAM hanizye sA durgeti prakIrttitA ॥ etAsu mUrttizu sadA pAdalagno nfRAM BavAn । pUjyo Bavizyasi tvaM vE devAnAmapi rakzasAm ॥ AdisfzwO ugracaRqAmUrttyA tvaM nihataH purA । dvitIyasfzwO tu BavAn BadrakAlyA mayA hataH ॥ durgArUpeRADunA tvAM hanizyAmi sahAnugam” । ityAdi ॥ * ॥ tasyAH prAdurBAvo yaTA । SrIBagavAnuvAca । “ugracaRqA tu yA mUrttirazwAdaSaBujA'Bavat । sA navamyAM purA kfzRapakze kanyAM gate ravO ॥ prAdurBUtA mahABAgA yoginIkowiBiH saha” ॥ * ॥ anyA mUrttyA dakzayajYaBaNgaH kftaH । yaTA, -- “AzAQasya tu pUrRAyAM satraM dvAdaSavArzikam । dakzaH karttuM samAreBe vftAH sarvve divOkasaH ॥ tato'haM na vftastena dakzeRa sumahAtmanA । kapAlIti satI cApi tajjAyeti ca no vftA ॥ tato rozasamAyuktA prARAMstatyAja sA satI । tyaktadehA satI cApi caRqamUrttistadABavat ॥ tataH pravftte yajYe tu tasmin dvAdaSavArzike । navamyAM kfzRapakze tu kanyAyAM caRqamUrttiDfk ॥ yoganidrA mahAmAyA yoginIkowiBiH saha । satIrUpaM parityajya yajYaBaNgamaTAkarot ॥ SaNkarasya gaREH sarvvEH sahitA SaNkareRa ca । svayaM baBaYja sA devI mahAsatraM mahAtmanaH ॥ tato devyA mahAkroDe vyatIte tridivOkasaH । pUjayAYcakruratulAM devIM pUrvvoditena vE ॥ pUrvvoditaviDAnena pUjAmasyA divOkasaH । kftvEva paramAmApurnirvftiM duHKahAnaye ॥ evamanyErapi sadA kAryyaM devyAH prapUjanam । viBUtimatulAM prAptuM caturvvargapradAyakam ॥ yo mohAdaTavAlasyAddevIM durgAM mahotsave । na pUjayati damBAdvA dvezAdvApyaTa BErava ॥ krudDA BagavatI tasya kAmAnizwAnnihanti vE । paratra ca mahAmAyAvalirBUtvA sa jAyate ॥ azwamyAM ruDirErmmAMsErmmahAmAMsEH suganDiBiH । pUjayedbahujAtIryErvvaliBirBojanEH SivAM” ॥ ityAdi ॥ * ॥ tanmantro yaTA, -- kfzRA sABUdgOrI kzaRAdapi ॥ kAlikAKyABavat sApi himAcalakftASrayA । tAmugratArAmfzayo vadantIha manIziRaH ॥ ugrAdapi BayAttrAti yasmAd BaktAn sadAmbikA । etasyAH praTamaM vIjaM kaTitaM tantrameva ca” ॥ * ॥ “ezEvEkajawAKyAtiryasmAttasyA jawADikA । SfRu tvaM cintanaM cAsyAH samyak vetAlaBEravO ॥ yaTA DyAtvA mahAdevIM BaktaH prApnotyaBIpsitam । caturBujAM kfzRavarRAM muRqamAlAviBUzitAm ॥ KaqgaM dakziRapARiByAM biBratIndIvaraM tvaDaH । kartrIYca KarparaYcEva kramAdvAmena biBratIm ॥ KaM liKantIM jawAmekAM biBratIM SirasA svayam । muRqamAlAM DarAM SIrze grIvAyAmapi sarvvadA ॥ vakzasA nAgahArantu biBratIM raktalocanAm । kfzRavastraDarAM kawyAM vyAGrAjinasamanvitAm ॥ vAmapAdaM Savahfdi saMsTApya dakziRaM padam । vinasya siMhapfzWe tu lelihAnA SavaM svayam ॥ sAwwahAsamahAGorA rAvayuktAtiBIzaRA । cintyogratArA satataM BaktimadBiH suKepsuBiH” ॥ * ॥ “etasyAH saMpravakzyAmi yA azwO yoginIstu tAH । mahAkAlyaTa rudrARI ugrA BImA taTEva ca । GorA ca BrAmarI cEva mahArAtriSca saptamI ॥ BEravI cAzwamI prIktA yoginIstAH prapUjayet” । iti kAlikApurARe 60 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ apica “brahmaSElasya pUrvvasyAM BUmipIWe vyavasTitA । “cArunimnaM SuBAvarttaM kAmAKyAnABimaRqalam ॥ yatrogratArArUpeRa ramate parameSvarI । tatra tenEva rUpeRa pUjitavyA SuBAtmikA ॥ tasyAstu vIjaM pUrvvasmin uttare pratipAditam । rUpaM SfRu naraSrezWa yena DyeyA sadASivA ॥ kfzRA lambodarI dIrGA viralA raktadantikA । caturBujA kfSANgI tu dakze karttfkaKarparO ॥ KaqgaM cendIvaraM vAme SIrze tvekajawAM punaH । vAmapAdaM SavasyorvvorniDAyotTAya dakziRam ॥ Savasya hfdaye nyasya sAwwahAsaM prakurvvatI । nAgahAraSiromAlABUzitA kAmadA parA ॥ trikoRaM maRqalaM cAsyA huMkAramaDyavIjakam । dvAre nAnAyoginInAM nAmAnyasyAstu tantrake ॥ jYeyAni naraSArddUla tatproktaM vAnyagocare” । iti kAlikApurARe kAmAKyArUpanirRaye 81 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ sA ca vaSizWaSApAt vAmA BUtA । yaTA, -- Orvva uvAca । “etadvizRorvvacaH SrutvA viDinA sahitaH sa tu । aNgIcakAra hfdaye tadvacaH sADyasADane ॥ visfjya tAn brahmavizRuyamAn vfzaBavAhanaH । AdAya sagaRAn sarvvAn kAmarUpAntaraM yayO ॥ ugratArAM tato devIM gaRAMSca prAha SaNkaraH । utsArayantu sakalAn imAn lokAn gaRA drutam ॥ ugratAre mahAdevi tvaYcApyutsAraya drutam ॥ tato gaRAH kAmarUpAddevIcApyaparAjitA । lokAnutsArayAmAsuH pIWaM karttuM rahasyakam ॥ utsAryyamAne loke tu caturvvarRErdvijAtiBiH । sanDyAcalo gato vipro vaSizWaH kupito muniH ॥ so'pyugratArayA devyA utsArayitumISayA । gaREH saha vftaH prAha SApaM kurvvan sudAruRam । yasmAdahaM DftaM vAme tvayotsArayituM muniH ॥ tasmAttvaM vAmyaBAvena pUjyA Bava samantrikA । Bartsyanti mlecCavat yasmAdgaRAste mandabadDayaH । Bavantu mlecCAstasmAdva BavatyA kABarUpake ॥ mahAdevo'pi yasmAnmAM niHsArayitumudyataH । tapobalaM muniM dAntaM mlecCavadvedapAragaB ॥ tasmAt mlecCapriyo BUyAt SaNkaraScAsTiBasmaDfk । etattu kAmarUpAKyaM mlecCErguptraM BavadbalaM ॥ svayaM vizRurna cAyAti yAvat kAlamidaM punaH । viralAScAgamAH santu yatra tatpratipAdakAH ॥ viralaM yastu SamBurmlecCarato'Bavat” । iti ca kAlikApurARe 83 aDyAyaH ॥
